scope: App-local Screen native-modal presentation correction and bounded no-effect regression; independent composition and full live Screen acceptance pending

sourceGuard.onlyProductChange: Two fullView(false) calls after existing showCredentials/showClipboard guards and before original modal construction
sourceGuard.newOracle: Actual popover-open descendants skip sticky application-bar subtraction; native dialogs retain native scroller bounds. Original inventory sticky-bar metrics remain excluded.

behavior.trigger: Active Screen fullViewport followed by an eligible credentialsrequired event or Clipboard activation
behavior.after: Existing fullView(false) runs after the existing stale/disposed/connected/duplicate guard, before native modal construction/show. Original native modal and private inputs remain Desktop-owned. Closing leaves the viewer inline; Fill window is explicit user re-entry.
behavior.preserved: Viewer/client/frame/native field and handler ownership, connection/cache/private clear and Cancel/disconnect semantics remain original. No automatic reconnect, transfer, credential submission or full-view restoration.

finding.positive: All 90 sampled field/button centers hit original controls with fullViewport off. Native title/initial close and sampled scroll-to-control allocations fit. Existing native modal pixels are visible in inspected initial/controls screenshots.
finding.counterfactual: Removing only the two new calls yields the exact original Screen module. At desktop and short phone, Clipboard and password-only auth stay under fullViewport; all 22 sampled centers miss. Captured winners are original Remote Mac screen DIV (20 samples) or original Stack DIV (2 short-phone samples), with null explicit role. Every winning element has an open-popover ancestor. This describes current counterfactual samples, not missing original-inventory hit identities.
finding.ancestry: Each field/control includes bounded tag/role/component ancestry (up to 10 elements) and popover ancestry flags. These are not a full DOM/RDF ownership export; source and GraphUI tests establish Desktop ownership separately.
finding.qualification: Sampled centers and inspected rasters only, no exhaustive entire-area or per-pixel occlusion. Actual inert frame host has no fake canvas or remote handlers.

affectedJS.scope: Two clipboard helper tests plus three selected Screen explicit-connect/invalid-session/lazy-cancel tests; full screen.test.mjs and populated-auth/error/overflow cases not run

productionGraphUIWAT.scope: Real Runtime/projection/EventBus/Islands/GraphUI with Linkedom; private sentinel excluded from all stored graph terms, native Island and Desktop ownership and fullViewport RDF facts. No browser pixel/focus evidence is inferred from Linkedom.

coverage.modalStates: Clipboard button/Escape close and empty password auth/header close at all four positive geometries; desktop additionally Clipboard header close, empty two-field auth/Escape and empty three-field auth/Cancel. Reopen uses existing cached clipboard; every close clears/detaches private fields.
coverage.focus: Clipboard initial focus is native dialog SECTION; auth initial focus is first INPUT. One Tab and Shift+Tab sample stays within each positive modal. Recorded after-close targets are Clipboard, Fill window or existing ARM button after Cancel. This is not a full focus traversal, guaranteed universal return policy or caption/value glyph proof.
coverage.keyboardScroll: Real native activation, Escape, Tab/Shift+Tab, textarea PageDown/ArrowRight and bounded selection/scroll samples. Textarea value remains intact; selected first/middle/final indices and actual scroll positions are recorded. Native glyph paint remains unavailable.
coverage.continuity: Each modal open retains same original client and frame, same constructor/load/disconnect/transfer counters. Close remains inline and same counters except existing Cancel adds one disconnect. Explicit Fill window re-entry and Escape tested after each eligible positive non-Cancel scenario.
coverage.lifecycle: All four positive geometries exercise stale old-client credentials/clipboard against healthy full view, pending synthetic clipboard read closed before resolution, actual client disconnect with modal open, public dispose from full view then late credential/clipboard/connect events. No modal/full-view re-entry; cache/private clears and original viewer disconnect observations recorded. Duplicate modal guard is additionally tested in production GraphUI using direct original Button events, not represented as a normal visible UI path.
coverage.noEffects: Same original main/native parents and unchanged approved two-dependency seam. Auth stays empty; sendCredentials hard-refuses/count0. Only existing bounded dummy clipboard and in-memory pending read calls; no send/write/request or genuine transfer. Global socket/clipboard/protocol module/endpoint guards count0. No screen-view authority is invented.

oracleLimits: Only the new fixture skips sticky application bars for actual popover-open descendants. Original inventory raw clip/full-fit flags and accepted exclusions remain unchanged.

Initial title/close, per-control scrolled bounds, field captions and native control/value metrics remain separate. No all-at-once visibility or native painted glyph bounds claim. Short/doubled-token Clipboard requires its native body scroller.
Private field font remains 15px at selected root/text token scale2; this is not universal font doubling or browser zoom. No maximum-size clipboard stress.

Counterfactual uses the same 45 frozen source files and inert dependencies with only the effective two-call inverse. It samples only two modal types/two geometries; positive keyboard/validation/close variations are not replayed as a whole identical user trace.
The original inventory exact hit-winner, full ancestry and focus gaps remain unknown; new counterfactual observations do not retroactively fill them.
limitations: Exactly one original normal FIFO core cohort and three original sequential FIFO browser cohorts (two positive, one allocated counterfactual). No failures/replacements, builds, installs, owner asset rebuild, Go/native/PTY/Linux/full suite, new window/task/worker overrides, peer monitoring, merge or push.
Only screen.mjs product changes: two presentation calls. No engine/pin/GraphUI/main/app.ttl/global z-index/native geometry/private reparenting/auth/clipboard/protocol/generation/permission changes.

No actual noVNC/ARD evaluation, framebuffer/canvas pixels, remote input, real clipboard/network/authentication, server resource grants or transport acceptance. Dummy native UI and in-memory facade observations only.

Original awaited capture/release/context/browser/server cleanup is positive, not OS group/reap, heap wipe/GC or main authentication-reset proof. CPU<=2 and memory target<=2GiB are cooperative limits; no hard enforcement or ARM grant is claimed.
No automatic full-view re-entry by design. Independent current-composition review/build and full Screen/live UX acceptance remain separate gates.
